Dear Parent,

Greetings.

Kindly update the Student and Parent profile information in your ward’s Parent Portal under the Profile section.

Please ensure that the following details are uploaded/updated:

- Recent formal photograph of each parent (plain background preferred)
- Student Blood Group
- Emergency Contact Number

These details are mandatory for the printing of Parent and Student ID cards.

Kindly update the details at the earliest to avoid any delay in issuing the ID cards.

Please note:
- The student photograph for the Student ID card will be taken in the school’s formal uniform at the school on commencement of the academic session.

- If any mandatory details are missing or incomplete, the printing of the Parent and Student ID cards cannot be completed.

- If your ward's profile information has already been updated, kindly ignore this message.

Regards,
Admin Head
NPS NORTH
